text: Gromark grows a key of digits from a few starting digits and uses a scrambled alphabet; it was ruled out exactly. One wrong, missing or extra carved letter could have spoiled that verdict.

605 versions of K4: each carved letter at the known places changed to every other letter, and the known words moved one place (a Gromark key depends on absolute position), through the three exact Gromark tests.
No version fits any rule, base or form: exact, so no scrambled copies are needed.
